title: Explaining Multi-modal Large Language Models by Analyzing their Vision Perception

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring changes in the model's numerical likelihood scores (1-10) for stereotypical occupations (e.g., 'nurse', 'construction worker') by applying semantic adversarial perturbations to the vision embedding that swap 'female person' and 'male person' representations in SDXL-generated portrait images.

Measuring changes in the model's numerical likelihood scores (1-10) for stereotypical traits (e.g., 'criminal', 'rich') by applying semantic adversarial perturbations to the vision embedding that swap 'African-American person' and 'Caucasian person' representations in SDXL-generated portrait images.
